pipeline.name: DAAD Research Grants, Doctoral Programmes in Germany
pipeline.institution: DAAD, via the Regional Office in Hanoi
pipeline.next_action: Supervisor confirmation letter and the safety and ethics declaration have to be in hand before the deadline, so supervisor outreach is the critical path, not the application form.
pipeline.notes: Funding runs from October 2027. Two questions still open: whether a Dr. sc. hum. from a medical faculty falls under DAAD's separate human-medicine regulations, and whether Hanoi or DAAD Thailand owns the file given Myanmar nationality with residence in Bangkok.

pipeline.name: Heidelberg Institute of Global Health, central doctoral route
pipeline.next_action: Denkinger enquiry went out 31 August 2026. The Mueller, Deckert and Dureab drafts are written and unsent; send them rather than waiting on one reply.
pipeline.notes: No deadline, reviewed quarterly. Three PDFs under 5MB total: cover letter 1 to 2 pages stating personal details, motivation, topics, preferred supervisor, previous contact and funding status; CV with grades, teaching, publications with hyperlinks and referee contacts; proposal of 1 to 2 pages. Pairs with the DAAD deadline above, which is where the money is.

pipeline.name: PhD scholarship, maternal RSV vaccination and child respiratory health
pipeline.next_action: CV and transcripts by email to Dr Fekede Kumsa (f.kumsa@unsw.edu.au). Ask in the same message whether a tuition fee scholarship exists for international applicants alongside the AUD 40,000 stipend.
pipeline.notes: Analysis of large linked routinely collected health datasets. Two gaps to name rather than hide: no experience with linked administrative data at population scale, and Stata rather than R.

pipeline.name: Individual Sandwich PhD, ITM-DGD 2027 call
pipeline.next_action: Decide whether to spend the days before the deadline on this at all. The scheme is built for ITM alumni embedded in a home institute, and the DGD priority list names Cambodia and Vietnam, not Myanmar.
pipeline.notes: Requires a home-country employer granting study leave and supplying a co-supervisor. That is the constraint, not the CV.

pipeline.name: PhD studentship, implementation research and mental health prevention
pipeline.next_action: Follow up with Prof. Dr. Daniela Fuhr if no reply.

pipeline.name: Doctoral supervision enquiry, humanitarian studies
pipeline.institution: International Institute of Social Studies, Erasmus University Rotterdam
pipeline.next_action: Send the supervision enquiry to Prof. Dorothea Hilhorst with the TB and armed conflict proposal.

pipeline.name: PhD opportunity, Public Health and Population Health track
pipeline.next_action: Follow up with Dr. Rakhi Verma.
pipeline.notes: Letter of motivation anchored on NCD screening and management in humanitarian settings.

pipeline.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027/28
pipeline.next_action: Check the RGC page for the published 2027/28 dates. The window above is a pattern from the 2026/27 cycle, not a published date.
pipeline.notes: No home-institution requirement, which is why it stays on this list. It selects heavily on publication record, so the thesis manuscript is the real prerequisite.

pipeline.name: Doctoral outreach, cardiovascular and chronic disease prevention
pipeline.institution: NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health
pipeline.next_action: Confirm the published November deadline on the school's own page.

pipeline.name: BOF sandwich PhD
pipeline.next_action: Watch for the next call, expected around February 2027.
pipeline.notes: The partner institution has to fund 24 months. Same constraint as ITM Antwerp, in a different shape.

pipeline.name: Implementation Research Leadership Fellowship
pipeline.institution: TDR at Universitas Gadjah Mada, Yogyakarta
pipeline.next_action: Watch for the next call, expected around December 2026. Requires employment plus study leave, and applicants must be under 40 at application. Whether it awards a degree was never confirmed.

pipeline.name: Full scholarship for Myanmar nationals
pipeline.institution: Mahidol University, Faculty of Tropical Medicine
pipeline.next_action: Decide whether a malaria and vivax topic is worth the change of subject. Open with no closing date given.
pipeline.notes: Restricted to Myanmar nationals, which for once is the right way round.

pipeline.next_action: Needs a supervisor agreement before anything else. 2027 commencement dates were not published when this was checked.
